comparison.objective: Load four connector modules into a hinged frame and close it until it clicks.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated precision module placement followed by bimanual frame closure and latch engagement.
comparison.success_condition: All four modules are seated, frame is clicked shut, hands are clear, and no module was crushed or dropped.
comparison.reason: Repeated insertion and latching share generic alignment but do not test hammer/mandrel coordination, notch fracture, retained-coil protection, or fragment containment.
